## Dubai 1-Bedroom Rental Shortlist for Summer 2026

A good fit for your brief is a **furnished 1BR in a metro-connected, mid-rise building** with **gym access, a full kitchen, and easy access to Dubai Internet City**. For your budget of **AED 9,000/month**, the strongest search zones are typically **Dubai Marina, JLT, Barsha Heights (Tecom), and Al Sufouh**.

## Best-Fit Property Features and Landlord Screening

| Priority | What to look for | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| Must-have | 1-bedroom, furnished, kitchen included | Matches your living setup and move-in needs |
| Must-have | Gym access in building or community | Keeps amenities simple and on-site |
| Must-have | Commute under 30 minutes to Dubai Internet City | Protects your daily travel time |
| Must-have | Rent at or below AED 9,000/month | Stays within budget |
| Strongly preferred | Near Metro or easy road access | Makes the commute more reliable |
| Strongly preferred | Chiller included or clearly itemized | Helps avoid surprise monthly costs |
| Strongly preferred | Balcony, laundry area, and dedicated parking | Improves comfort for a longer stay |
| Strongly preferred | Flexible lease dates for 2026-07-01 to 2026-08-15 | Important for your exact move window |
| Check carefully | DEWA, internet, cleaning, and security deposit terms | Prevents hidden total-cost issues |
| Check carefully | Whether the kitchen is fully equipped | Confirms it is truly move-in ready |

## Screening Checklist for Each Listing

- Is it a **true 1-bedroom** and not a studio marketed as a one-bed?
- Is it **fully furnished** with bed, sofa, dining setup, and storage?
- Does the kitchen include **fridge, stove/oven, microwave, cookware, and basic appliances**?
- Is **gym access** included in the building or nearby community?
- Is the commute to **Dubai Internet City** under **30 minutes at peak and off-peak**?
- Is the quoted rent **monthly**, and does it include any service charges?
- Are **DEWA, internet, chiller, and parking** included or extra?
- Is the lease available for your dates: **2026-07-01 to 2026-08-15**?
- Is there a **security deposit**, and when is it refundable?
- Are there any **minimum stay** or cancellation rules?
- Can the landlord provide **recent photos, floor plan, and exact tower/building name**?
- Is the listing handled by a **verified agent or direct landlord**?

## Message to Send Landlords

Hello, I’m looking for a **furnished 1-bedroom apartment in Dubai** for **1 July 2026 to 15 August 2026**.

My requirements:
- Budget: **up to AED 9,000 per month**
- Furnished unit
- Kitchen included
- Gym access
- **Commute under 30 minutes to Dubai Internet City**

Please share:
- Monthly rent and all included/excluded costs
- Exact building name and location
- Photos and floor plan
- Availability for my dates
- Deposit amount and refund terms
- Whether DEWA, internet, chiller, and parking are included

If available, I’d be happy to arrange a viewing or receive a virtual tour. Thank you.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Barsha Heights] https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/search?c=1&l=224&fu=0&rp=y&ob=mr

- Dubai Internet City area reference: https://www.dubaiinternetcity.com/
- Property search starting point: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/
- Dubai rental market listings: https://www.bayut.com/for-rent/apartments/dubai/
